concerns.text: FR-006 (Sensitivity Analysis) is anchored to US-3, but US-3 (Evaluation) does not mention sensitivity analysis or threshold sweeping. The scope of US-3 is limited to success rate, step efficiency, and t-test against a random baseline. This FR introduces a new evaluation dimension not requested by any user story.

SC-005 (Robustness of Threshold) measures variance across inconsistency tolerance thresholds. This metric is not defined in any User Story. US-3 only defines Success Rate, Step Efficiency, and statistical significance (p-value). SC-005 is orphaned from the user goals.

The 'Assumption about statistical power' mentions '[deferred] power' but does not link to a specific User Story or FR that defines how this power will be calculated or validated. While the assumption itself is valid, the lack of a corresponding requirement or story to operationalize this check leaves the statistical validation plan incomplete.
